title: ChatGPT bet C$6,000 on a −148 favourite. It won 131-123. #AI #ChatGPT #NBA
description:
3 AIs (Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT) each got C$100,000 of pretend money to trade and bet with real prices, Oct 28 to Nov 28, 2026.
ChatGPT bet C$6,000 on the Los Angeles Lakers moneyline at −148 (Los Angeles Lakers @ Phoenix Suns). Its reason, from the public ledger: "The high-risk book can take a larger but still survivable position on the same modest Lakers edge rather than forcing an extreme favorite or parlay."
Final: Los Angeles Lakers 131, Phoenix Suns 123. ChatGPT won C$4,054.
Check it yourself: transaction IDs X-AIS-032 and X-AIS-033 at PaperTrades.AI
Pretend money. Not betting or investment advice.
